Definition: properly, ago, i.e. a (short or long) time since; especially yesterday, or day before yesterday
BiblicalUsage: The word is ago, yesterday, formerly, a time since. Moses says, O my Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since Thou hast spoken unto Thy servant; Jacob saw that Laban's face was not toward him as before; and Boaz tells Ruth that all she did for her mother in law since the death of her husband has been shewed him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that as before is the measure of change: Laban's face changed, and Moses' tongue did not.
